### Pricing Objection Responses

| Objection | Response Framework |
|-----------|-------------------|
| "It's too expensive" | "Compared to what? Let's look at cost per protected patient per month" |
| "Competitor is cheaper per unit" | "Per unit, yes. But factor in compliance rate — cost per PROTECTED patient is lower with us" |
| "We can't afford to switch" | "What's the cost of staying? We quantified $X in waste/missed revenue" |
| "No budget this quarter" | "Would a funded trial (samples + 30 days) help you build the case for next quarter?" |
| "Need to think about it" | "Of course. What specific numbers would help you make the decision?" |
